risk_if_not_implemented: Without Technical Surveillance Countermeasures Security, unauthorized individuals may gain physical access to facilities and equipment, enabling theft, tampering, damage or safety incidents. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Intellectual Property / Trade Secret Loss (R-EX-9), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Technical Surveillance Countermeasures Security (VPM-20) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Penetration Testing
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct penetration testing on Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).
compensating_control_2.justification: Penetration Testing (VPM-18) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Technical Surveillance Countermeasures Security (VPM-20) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
